findings.finding: Current debug arm64 bundle links Qt/hiredis under /opt/homebrew and starts local music adapter from repository scripts; not self-contained.
findings.verification: Read-only otool dependency inspection and source inspection.

findings.finding: Current bundle is ad-hoc signed, has no TeamIdentifier; strict signature verification fails; release versions and target OS/dependency deployment targets need reconciliation.
findings.verification: codesign -dv and codesign --verify --deep --strict; failure text: code has no resources but signature indicates they must be present.

findings.finding: Except server-owned catalogLanguage, full model Brief replacement can silently clear duration, required artist and exclusion constraints on a style-only turn.
findings.verification: Pure local validateBrief adversarial proposal accepted; demonstrates missing guard, not a newly observed real-provider failure.
findings.next: Explicit field patch and deterministic merge; clearing conditions is a first-class operation.

findings.finding: Resume is offered after per-run budget exhaustion but preserves exhausted runCalls and immediately fails again.
findings.verification: Isolated temporary SQLite and stub model, maxRunCalls=1: exhausted -> resume -> exhausted, provider calls remain 1.
findings.next: Distinguish per-run, total-task and daily caps; provide actionable recovery without bypassing quotas.

findings.finding: Two tasks for the same account can wait for tools then overlap model calls despite documented one-call account limit.
findings.verification: Isolated in-memory SQLite/model stub reproduced simultaneousModelCalls=2. Global concurrency and daily caps remain in force.
findings.next: Account-level scheduler or semaphore shared by all AI routes.

findings.finding: Registration grants immediate operator-funded model access; no invite/approval/account verification. Multiple accounts can consume the shared daily pool.
findings.next: Invite beta, account disable/revocation, per-account and global spend visibility/kill switch.

findings.finding: Server persists instruction, preference and messages in task JSON; no account/task deletion or retention cleanup and no backup/restore drill implementation.
findings.next: Accurate data disclosure, deletion/retention policy, backup and recovery exercise.

findings.finding: No verified public HTTPS deployment, process supervision, alerting or rollback/backup workflow; single-process rate/concurrency state must not be represented as multi-instance protection.
Music service dependency audit reports 6 high and 1 moderate dependency alerts; backend reports zero. Route reachability is not yet established.
findings.verification: npm audit --omit=dev --json; no install, forced fix or dependency change performed.
findings.next: Resolve or document each reachable/unused path; do not apply suggested forced major downgrade blindly.

findings.finding: Current two passed multi-turn live cases were repeatedly tuned; no held-out success-rate or listening-quality proof. Old memory baseline excludes new Node processes and long playback.
findings.next: Frozen unused multi-turn set, constraint/failure/latency/cost metrics, actual playback and blind comparison, full-process long-run memory profile.

findings.finding: Project uses a third-party NetEase adapter; no official commercial catalog authorization evidence was found in the repository. Legal eligibility is not determined by this code audit.
findings.next: Establish authorized scope and fallback service behavior; include dependency license notices.
